title: Deployment approval, progress, health, drift, logs, history, and rollback UX
intended_behavior: One linkable deployment view follows the signed intent through policy, approval, execution phases, redacted logs, runtime health, drift, and completion.
The workflow coordinator is the sole execution owner; rejection never creates a run or mutates runtime state.
Compose deployment success requires a healthy observation and preserves healthy in_sync state across completion and restart recovery.
Failed health convergence exposes a safe reason and one-click rollback to an explicit prior artifact through a fresh policy-checked intent.
Relay delay, reconnect, corrected coordinates, and duplicate projections converge deterministically.
